card.name: Lists of compatible IV fluids
card.fires_on: Linking words, colons, commas and bullets just before a named IV diluent such as sodium chloride, dextrose or Lactated Ringer's. Seen in dilution and compatibility passages.

modes.label: List punctuation between fluids
modes.description: A colon, bullet, comma or 'or' sits between named diluents in a list.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word 'function' and away from 'value' words, which gives no useful clinical meaning.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or mark right before the name of an IV fluid in a list of compatible diluents.
